note: The engine holds no rule logic: each case seeds the answers already collected and sends the last one. The rule traits are the atom's composed rules (the rules knob lists every rule name they answer with; a pass settles when each expected name has answered, the programOnlyRules names being expected of the program pass only); the final-only rules' findings leave `findings` and `found` for `final`. Lazy children: after the program's pass the engine asks the input once per LINT_LAZY orbital (LINT_CHILD_REQUEST { index }) and prefixes each child finding's path `lazy[<orbital>].`; LINT_COLLECTED carries the program's and every child's findings.
